rows.title_full: AN ACT REVERTING THE FUNCTION OF SUPPRESSING INSURGENCY FROM THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE (PNP) TO THE ARMED FORCES OF THE PHILIPPINES (AFP), AMENDING THEREBY SECTION TWELVE (12) OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6975, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT ACT OF 1990
rows.abstract: Declares that THE FUNCTION OF SUPPRESSING INSURGENCY, REBELLION, OR INSURRECTION SHALL BE REVERTED FROM THE PNP TO THE AFP. Is premised on the following : (1) PNP resources are very limited; (2) The AFP is in a better position to address the problemof insurgency considering its orientation, superior equipment, expertise, etc. (3) The proposal will ensure maximum utilization of AFP personnel, equipment and funds.

Covers all employees ad workers REGARDLESS OF THEIR STATUS AND MODE OF PAYMENT. rows.abstract: Proposes a Commission on Women that shall exercise corporate powers, have a seal, may sue and be sued, and be the primary olicy-making and coordinating body of all women development programs and institutions in the Philippines. rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE FOREIGN POLICY COUNCIL, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Prescribes the purposes and objectives of the proposed FOREIGN POLICY COUNCIL as follows: (1) To establish the legal basis, framework and mechanisms for the creation of the Foreign Policy Council; (2) To create and develop the Council's capability and mission as a high-level policy-coordina ting/making body, or clearing house mechanism; and (3) To provide the government with a wider range of well-crafted foreign policy options and recommendation for decision-making .

rows.title_full: AN ACT SUPERVISING, REGULATING AND CONTROLLING THE LICENSURE AND PRACTICE OF ELECTRONICS ENGINEERS AND ELECTRONICS TECHNICIANS
rows.abstract: "New Electronics Engineering Law of the Philippines" Provides for the categories of electronics engineering and electronics technician practice, the scope and nature of the practice of these professions and the prohibitions and limitations on the exercise of such functions. Increases from three (3) to FIVE (5) members the composition of the Board of Electronics Engineering under the supervision of the Professional Regulation Commission. Includes provisions on consultations with the Commission on Higher Education (CHED) and the Technical Education and Skills Development Authority (TESDA) on the essential requirements as to curricula, schools facilities and courses to be offered.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10545

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE INTEGRATION OF THE NURSING PROFESSION
rows.abstract: Seeks to integrate the nursing profession into an association to be known as the integrated PNA (PHIlippine Nurses Association). rows.author: A103
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO INSTITUTE THE POLICIES ON THE SUPPRESSION OF TRAFFICKING OF FILIPINO WOMEN; AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A HIGHER STANDARD OF PROTECTION AND REHABILITATION OF VICTIMS OF TRAFFICKING, FORCED PROSTITUTION, SEXUAL SERVITUDE AND EXPLOITATION INCLUDING COMMERCIALIZED TRANSNATIONAL MARRIAGES, MIGRATION FOR ENTERTAINMENT, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "The Ati-Trafficking of Filipino Women Act of 1996" Recognizes the equal rights and inherent human dignity of women and men. Declares it a State policy to bring national law and practice into compliance with international standards so as to insure full protection and assistance to women. Establishes the INTER-AGENCY COUNCIL AGAINST TRAFFICKING tasked to monitor compliance with this Act.
rows.status: Substituted by HB09361

rows.abstract: "Maritime Transport Safety Act of 1996" Aims to curb, if not totally stop,the recurrence of maritime disasters in the Philippines. Seeks to create Maritime Safety Councils in every port of origin which shall coordinate, prepare and integrate plans and programs of the government in relation to maritime affairs.

rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING THE MONTH OF DECEMBER OF EVERY YEAR AS 'DISASTER-AT-SE A' AWARENESS MONTH AND PROVIDING CERTAIN MEASURES FOR SAFE SEA TRAVEL
rows.abstract: Tasks the Maritime Industry Authority (MARINA) to conduct an information campaign to raise public awareness on the hazards and risks of travelling at sea and to institute measures so that all the necessary precautions and safeguards can be taken. Aims to compel ship owners to review the seaworthiness of their vessels and to require higher standards of training for their crew.

rows.abstract: Seeks to create a Disease Prevention Center, a special agency attached to the Department of Health which would serve as the country's vigilant professional sentinel against the outbreak of emerging and reemerging infectious diseases. Tasks said Center to conduct more intense activities in the surveillance, research and prevention of the influx and spread of epidemic viral deiseases.

rows.author: A102
rows.title_full: AN ACT IMPOSING STIFFER PENALTIES FOR CERTAIN INSTANCES OF QUALIFIED THEFT THEREBY AMENDING ARTICLE 310, CHAPTER THREE OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 3815, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE REVISED PENAL CODE
rows.abstract: Imposes the penalty of RECLUSION TEMPORAL in its MAXIMUM period to RECLUSION PERPETUA for certain instances of QUALIFIED THEFT on the occasion of the following, or immediately thereafter: a) fire, earthquake, typhoon or any other calamity; b) civildisturbance, public want or emergency; c) vehicular accidents.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 1996-04-30
